mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, it is currently 50 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. Please be aware that we have a moderate air quality alert with an index of 51, and the moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

The City of Verona has provided updates on refuse and recycling services handled by Pellitteri Waste Systems, and reminds all residents that alternate-side winter parking regulations start on November 20 through April 1. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

In a noteworthy call from the weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a man for a first offence O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
